Summed to county level over the common 2015-2019 window, Kiama totals 29,015 against Boru's 22,172 - Boru is 24% lower overall and lower in 30 of the 35 counties with cases, exactly as expected of a source that discards records with unresolved sub-county. The comparison CONFIRMS both the usability of Boru's positives and the unusability of its zeros. THE POSITIVES AGREE: Kiambu 323 vs 322, Kisumu 165 vs 163, Siaya 862 vs 848, Tana River 1,349 vs 1,310, Nakuru 449 vs 412. ONE YEAR-ASSIGNMENT DISAGREEMENT worth knowing: North Horr (Marsabit) carries 365 cases in Boru's 2020 column and the same 365 inside Kiama's Jan 2015 - Dec 2019 cumulative. Description: Kenya's last appearances in the WER notification table. Issue 8 of 2000 reports 1.X-31.XII = 435/8, which is the missing fourth quarter of 1999 and completes that year's series (1999 deaths then total 349 against a published annual of 350). The four periods covering 2000 - 6-19.I = 192/3, 20.I-2.IV = 357/17, 3.IV-31.X = 541/54 and 1.XI-31.XII = 67/3 - sum to EXACTLY 1 157 cases, the published 2000 annual, with 77 deaths against 78.
